draft.title: Unlimited and limited liability
card: Liability is an owner's legal duty to pay the debts of the business. If the business cannot pay, creditors (the people it owes money to) may go after the owners.
the owner's personal assets, such as a house or savings, can be taken to pay business debts. Sole traders and partners have this. The business and the owner are not separate in law.
a shareholder can lose only the money they put into the company. Their personal assets are safe from the company's debts. Owners of companies have this.
In a partnership, each partner can be held responsible for the business debts, even debts made by another partner.
draft.remember: Unlimited liability puts the owner's own assets at risk. Limited liability risks only the money invested.

a.q: Jin is a sole trader whose bakery cannot pay its debts. What can happen to Jin?
opts: Personal assets such as savings can be used to pay the debts
Only the money Jin first put into the bakery can be lost
Jin's own assets are safe because the bakery owes the debt
The debts pass to the customers who bought from the bakery
a.why: A sole trader has unlimited liability, so the business and the owner are not separate in law. Creditors can claim Jin's personal assets. The option about losing only the money put in describes limited liability, which sole traders do not have.
a.clue: Think about whether a sole trader is separate from the business in law.

b.q: Priya invested $10,000 to buy shares in a private company. The company fails with debts of $400,000. What is the most Priya can lose?
opts: Her $10,000 plus a share of the debts
Her house and savings, up to the debts owed
b.why: Shareholders have limited liability, so Priya can lose only what she invested. The large debt does not reach her personal assets. Losing a share of the debts or her house would be unlimited liability, which applies to sole traders and partners.
b.clue: The size of the company's debt does not decide a shareholder's loss.

a.best: Personal assets such as savings can be used to pay the debts
